Create SAP B1 User Defined Table (UDT)

1
Table Info
2
Add Fields
3
Review & Confirm
Will be stored as @TABLENAME · Max 15 chars · Letters, numbers, underscore only
No Object
Standalone table with no document or master data linkage. Most common for configuration.
Master Data
Master data header table (like Items or Business Partners). Has DocEntry & Code fields.
Master Data Lines
Child rows of a Master Data UDT. Linked via DocEntry foreign key.
Document
Transaction document header (like Sales Orders). Has DocEntry, DocNum, DocDate.
Document Lines
Line rows of a Document UDT. Linked to header via DocEntry.

Add fields for table . Field names are auto-prefixed with U_ · Max 8 chars.

Field Name * Description Type Size

Fields are optional — you can add them later from SAP B1 directly. Each field will be created as U_FieldName.

MRP Auto-PO AI
Live SAP data
👋 MRP Auto-PO AI Agent
I automate your full purchase order lifecycle:
● MRP scan → items below reorder point
● Vendor & pricing lookup (OCRD / ITM1)
● Draft POs grouped by vendor
● SAP approval workflow & email vendor
Tap a suggestion or type your question.
Run MRP & Generate Draft POs
Clicking Run MRP will:
1. Scan all inventory items against reorder points (OITM)
2. Identify items below minimum stock threshold
3. AI reads vendor (OCRD), pricing (ITM1), payment terms (OCTG)
4. Build draft POs grouped by preferred vendor
5. Show results in Tabs for review before posting to SAP

Dynamic Pricing Agent LIVE Adjusts pricing in real time based on demand signals, competitor data, inventory levels & margin targets
Scenario Action Trigger Condition Price Change Formula Data Sources
Dead Stock ▼ Decrease Stock on hand > 0 AND zero sales in last 12 months −15% of current price Qty on hand (Items), Sales qty (SMLSVC)
Discount Recovery ▲ Increase Avg selling price is >15% below the implied (target-margin) price +(discountDepth × 0.7)%, max 15%
discountDepth = (impliedPrice − avgPrice) / impliedPrice × 100		 Avg realized price (SMLSVC revenue÷qty), Implied price (cost÷(1−margin%))
Margin Recovery ▲ Increase Current GP% is more than 2% below margin target +(|marginGap| × 1.3)%, max 20%
marginGap = ((price−cost)/price×100) − target%		 AvgStdPrice (Items), Avg selling price (SMLSVC), GP% target (user input)
Shortage Pricing ▲ Increase Demand HIGH (>200 units/yr) AND stock below minimum +8% flat Sales qty (SMLSVC), On hand vs MinInventory (Items)
Demand Capture ▲ Increase Demand HIGH AND stock normal/overstocked AND margin not above target +5% flat Sales qty (SMLSVC), On hand vs MaxInventory, GP% (Items + SMLSVC)
Margin Improvement ▲ Increase Demand MEDIUM (30–200 units/yr) AND margin below target +|marginGap|%, max 10% Sales qty (SMLSVC), GP% vs target (Items + SMLSVC)
Overstock Clearance ▼ Decrease Stock > MaxInventory × 1.1 AND demand not high −7% (low/medium demand) or −12% (no demand) On hand vs MaxInventory (Items), Sales qty (SMLSVC)
Market Alignment ▲ Increase Realized GP% < industry benchmark (35%) by >5% AND demand exists +8% flat Realized GP% (SMLSVC), Industry benchmark 35% (fixed)
Price Establishment ▲ Increase No selling price in SAP — priced at cost or unpriced stock +marginTarget% above cost
suggestedPrice = cost / (1 − target%)		 AvgStdPrice (Items), GP% target (user input)
Balanced ● Hold None of the above conditions met 0% — no change All signals within acceptable range
Price Source Priority: 1 Avg realized selling price = SMLSVC NetSalesAmountLC ÷ QuantityInInventoryUoM  |  2 Implied price = AvgStdPrice ÷ (1 − marginTarget%)  |  3 Cost floor = AvgStdPrice  |  4 Unpriced stock (placeholder)  ·  Demand thresholds: High > 200 units/yr · Medium 30–200 · Low >0 · None = 0
